meta.name: pr-lens
meta.description: WHAT: Draws a code change or part of a codebase as an animated architecture or data-flow diagram, on its own or in a pull request. WHEN: asked to diagram, visualise or explain a change or a system, or when a pull request should carry a diagram. KEYWORDS: PR Lens, diagram, architecture, data flow, visualise, visualize, pull request

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把一次代码改动或整套系统画成会动的架构图,一眼看清数据怎么流
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让同事不读代码也能看懂这次改动或这套系统的结构
copy.tagline_en: Draw any code change or system as an animated architecture diagram.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want reviewers to grasp a change or system without reading every line.

howto.what: Claude 会把一次代码改动或代码库的一部分画成带动画的架构图或数据流图:先写出一份 JSON 图文档,校验后渲染成 SVG,再推到在线画布给出链接,或附进 PR。
howto.when: 当你要求画图、可视化或解释某个改动或系统时,或当一次 PR 应该带上一张图时触发。

say.text: 把这次改动画成架构图
say.note: 生成图并返回画布链接

say.text: 把这张图加到 PR 描述里
say.note: 渲染出的 SVG 会随 PR 一起上传

say.text: 解释一下 push 先检查什么
say.note: 在打开的页面上分步演示并高亮

howto.what_en: Claude draws a code change or part of a codebase as an animated architecture or data-flow diagram: it writes a JSON graph document, validates it, renders animated SVGs, then pushes a canvas link or attaches the diagram to a PR.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to diagram, visualise or explain a change or a system, or when a pull request should carry a diagram.

say_en.text: Diagram this change as an architecture view
say_en.note: Renders the SVGs and returns a canvas link

say_en.text: Add the diagram to the PR description
say_en.note: The SVG is uploaded with the pull request
Steps through the open canvas and highlights parts
